notes.review: It ran five times, and no pass found a High problem. The Medium ones were all fixed. Wallace Reyburn is now named in large type. Card-only runs got real photos (Crapper, Knossos, the S-bend drawing under the words "S-bend"). A ballcock patent by someone else was taken out of the "he made the toilet better" line. The timeline no longer gives away the ending early. The title card no longer names Harington and Cumming before the cold open reveals them. The final pass was clean.
